title: Eval skill: a defect card filed from a scenario-eval round must not carry eval-run (the QA runner's twin rule)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaAqjP52wVTzs99H5G

Filing gate: ① a rule gap with a named location, found in landed work's review (PR #35532 contract review, comment 7012326518, N4). Source: fleet. Grading: `area:fleet · Task · p3 · reach: every finding a scenario-eval round extracts; none mis-labelled on the board today (the six eval-run cards are all records) · evidence: read`. Parent: #35470.

Business reason: PR #35532 took `eval-run` out of every patrol (the first-touch sweep, H13, H74 and the grade row), as the maintainer ruled on 2026-11-19 (run records take no area; eval is run like QA). The QA route has a rule that keeps a finding out of that exclusion. The eval route does not have it yet. So a product defect filed with `eval-run` beside it would be read by no patrol.

Duplicate search, open and closed: `is:issue scenario-eval defect card eval-run` and `is:issue eval-run round-end open records` found #34118, #34920, #34869, #33923 and #35470. #34118 (open, area:fleet) is the other half of the review's N4: a reader for `eval-run` records left open. This card is only the filing rule. They touch different files and can land in either order.

## What is wrong

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md:1143-1144` says: "A defect card does not carry `qa-run`; it enters triage first-touch normally."
- `.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md` §6 (「发现 —— 各归各主」, line 149 on main f981dce3be) routes product defects through the filing gate. It does not say the defect card leaves `eval-run` off.

## What lands

1. One sentence in `scenario-eval/SKILL.md` §6: a finding card does not carry `eval-run`, and it enters triage first-touch normally. Mirror RUNNER's wording. Keep the file at or under its line ceiling, with no ceiling edit.
2. If a pin reads that section, extend it.
3. `.claude/**` only (governed, Tier S). `skip-changeset`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Done when

§6 carries the rule, and the skill's line ratchet and governed-prose gates pass.
